summary: candidate O on Cu(111) (adsorbate_on_metal_surface, trust tier)

O on Cu(111) adsorption_energy = -4.44 eV via ASE 3.29 + mace-torch 0.3.15 (MACECalculator, float64, CUDA)/MACE-MP-0 medium (2023-12-03, trained on MPtrj PBE/PBE+U) 0 K static relaxations (BFGS, fmax 0.01 eV/A). Bulk fcc Cu relaxed with cell filter -> a = 3.626 A. Cu(111) slab 3x3 in-plane, 5 layers, 8 A vacuum each side (16 A gap), bottom 2 layers fixed. O placed at fcc, hcp, ontop, bridge and relaxed (bridge relaxes into fcc). E_ads = E(slab+O) - E(slab) - E(O atom); E(O atom) = MACE energy of a single O in a 15 A box (non-spin-polarized model, so this is the model's isolated-atom baseline). Most stable site is fcc hollow. Convergence checks: 2x2x4 (0.25 ML) -4.428, 3x3x4 -4.436, 3x3x5 -4.436 eV.
